$comment: Ovrly contracts 0.1.0-draft (pre-1.0). The action allowlist mirrors BC-D04 and is Conditional until AN-09 (#35) wires the client; a change to the enum is a breaking change and requires a version bump.
title: VoiceActionRequest
description: Request body for POST /v1/voice/actions (BE-10, #33). Exactly one allowlisted action against exactly one typed target. There are no free-form arguments; confirmation of queue_cancel happens on the device and is never sent to the server.

request_id.description: Client-generated idempotency key, unique per attempted action. Repeating a request with the same request_id must return the original outcome without executing the action again.

action.description: Allowlisted action name, exact and case-sensitive. The client-local switch_tab action is deliberately absent; it never reaches the backend.

target.description: The single object the action applies to. Its kind must match the action (see oneOf).

opaque_id.description: Opaque, case-sensitive identifier: 1 to 128 ASCII characters, starting with a letter or digit, then letters, digits, underscore or hyphen. Matches the Android VoiceCommandContract syntax; no trimming or coercion.

kind.description: Resource type the id refers to.

id.description: Identifier of the target as previously shown to this caller. Valid syntax does not imply existence or ownership.
